sentences.en: Everything is perishable, but the good memories live.
sentences.zh: 一切都会消逝，但美好的回忆会永存。

sentences.en: Music is the most perishable of things, fragile and delicate, easily destroyed.
sentences.zh: 音乐是所有事物中最易逝的，脆弱而细腻，极易被破坏。

sentences.en: Fresh figs are very fragile and highly perishable.
sentences.zh: 新鲜无花果非常娇嫩，且极易腐烂。

senses.zh: 易腐烂的；会枯萎的；会死的
